system.description:
You or a nearby willing creature takes the shape of any mundane object you can think of, such as a hammer or an arrow in a quiver. In this state, the affected creature retains its senses and can speak telepathically to nearby creatures. In their transformed state, they can be used by another creature as a crude tool (d6 depletion die). Each time they are used, they must make a depletion check or revert to their normal form. You can also dismiss the spell with a mental gesture, causing the subject to spring suddenly back to its original shape.

The spell lasts for 10 minutes (one dungeon round). With each spark, you can affect one additional creature, double the duration, or increase the quality of the tool by one step, to a maximum of superior.
